rows.text: Ministry of Home Affairs notification of 5 July 1991: the President has been pleased to accept the resignation of Shri Chandra Shekhar of his office of Prime Minister, and of the listed members of the Council of Ministers, with effect from 21 June 1991.

locator.item: Ministry of Home Affairs Notification No. 10/4/91-M&G(i), New Delhi, the 5th July, 1991 (Hindi text on page 1)

bounded_scope: Head-of-government observations for CLAUDE-C01-11 only.
